headline: Russia Pressures European Companies Over Ukraine While Sparing US Businesses
summary: Russian authorities are selectively targeting European commercial firms operating in the country over their governments' backing of Ukraine, while largely sparing US businesses amid shifting diplomatic contacts.
why: Multinational companies maintaining residual assets in Russia face operational expropriation and asset-freeze risks.

impacts.name: European Multinationals
impacts.why: Regulatory and legal pressure increases exit impairment and operational disruption risks in Russia.
